olga: Heads-up: planning a 'minimal runtime rebuild' next week to strip cruft from base images and re-sign. Need RBAC/JIT, audit sinks, vuln gating, and incident rollback spelled out.
matt: Thumbs up. Proposal: avoid granting roles/cloudkms.signer directly. Use short-lived SA impersonation for the builder: create `svc-image-impersonator` with iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken on the signer SA, time-limited via IAM Conditions.
dena: Could you sketch the impersonation flow? We need exact commands for the runbook.
matt: Flow: 1) create a short-lived keyless impersonation token with `gcloud iam service-accounts signBlob --impersonate-service-account=svc-image-builder@proj` (or use `gcloud auth print-identity-token --impersonate-service-account=...`), 2) use that token to call KMS-asymmetric sign endpoint rather than changing key IAM bindings. This avoids changing key policy.
olga: That sounds safer. But some infra teams prefer the explicit add/remove binding approach because it's simple. Which do we actually have bandwidth for?
dena: We have infra cycles. I'd rather avoid touching the KMS key IAM. If we implement impersonation, we still must make sure the audit logs show who impersonated whom. Also add a conditional binding that requires a tag `rebuild-window=true` on the request (IAM Condition) if we do binding route.
matt: Agreed. If impersonation is used, ensure Cloud Audit Logs include the `principalEmail` field and we emit a build detail to SIEM with `build_id` + `initiator`.
sec-bot: Note: created alert `image-signing-activity` -> routes to #eng-oncall and will auto-open incident for any signer usage outside scheduled window.
olga: Vulnerability gating: capture pre-scrub baseline (trivy + grype) and SBOM. After rebuild, generate SBOM (syft), run `trivy fs --severity CRITICAL,HIGH ./rootfs` and `grype sbom:sbom.json`. If any NEW CRITICAL appears post-rebuild, auto-abort and rollback.
dena: How do we determine "new" CRITICAL? We'll diff CVE IDs between pre and post. If any post CRITICAL not in pre list or the CVE score increased to CRITICAL, fail.
matt: Add the automated check into the pipeline: `python scripts/diff_vulns.py --pre pre.json --post post.json` -> exit 1 if new CRITICALs. Attach outputs to the release PR.
olga: Runtime canaries: deploy canary with label `canary=rebuild-test`, 3 pods, 4m warmup, synthetic traffic hitting `/healthz` and a lightweight predict. Require 98% success and <200ms p95. If thresholds fail, rollback.
dena: Also validate telemetry: 1) IAM policy logs and KMS CryptoKeyVersion access logs -> sink to `projects/redwood-logs/sinks/kms-signing`; 2) push artifact metadata (cosign sigs/attestations) into Artifact Registry metadata; 3) binaryauthorization attestations appear in `containeranalysis`.
matt: Example cosign sign (asymmetric KMS): ```cosign sign-blob --key ksm://projects/PROJ/locations/global/keyRings/kr/cryptoKeys/signer#1 --attachment sbom.json artifacts/my-image.tar``` We'll record the rekor/attestation ID.
olga: Ops runbook snippet: "If canary fails: 1) scale back to :signed-vN, 2) run revoke-impermanent-credentials (if impersonation tokens still active), 3) create incident and tag as `image-rebuild-failure` with attached vuln diff and logs."
sec-bot: Reminder rule set for scheduled window `2026-03-12T09:00:00Z` created; will post 30m before to #eng-security.
dena: RBAC audit: require two approvals in PR: one from an engineer and one from Security. The PR must include the pre/post SBOM + trivy outputs and the planned rollback image tag.
matt: I'll implement the impersonation helper and a short script to list sign usages: `gcloud logging read "resource.type=kms_crypto_key AND protoPayload.methodName:AsymmetricSign" --freshness=1d` and post to SIEM.
olga: Good. One more risk: cosign key provenance. Ensure cosign uses a KMS-backed asymmetric key with protection via HSM (if supported) and record the KMS key version used in attestations.
dena: Incident play: if someone notices a mismatch between cosign signature and AR metadata, treat as a potential signing compromise: stop rollout, revoke any active impersonation grants, rotate signer key ring (create new version), and run forensic collection on the builder runner.
matt: I'll add a forensic checklist: collect build logs, list active tokens for builder SA, export audit logs for the timeframe, capture image digests, and snapshot the builder runner.
olga: Action items: matt = impersonation helper + logging query; dena = vuln diff script + SBOM attachments; olga = runbook + schedule; sec-bot/kms-bot = ensure alerts/incidents wired. Please ack when PRs live. :thumbsup:
matt: ack, starting PR `infra/impersonate-signer`.
dena: ack, pushing `tools/diff_vulns.py` and pipeline change.
sec-bot: Scheduled reminder: `2026-03-12T08:30:00Z` -> posted to #eng-security.
olga: Thanks — we'll reconvene 48h before to verify pre-scrub baselines.
